description: Resolves the 150 vs 152 record discrepancy across v0.2 review manifests. Declares the authoritative source and documents phantom ID mappings. No decision files, curated datasets, or release metadata are modified.

authoritative_manifest.reason: Original manifest generated at review setup time with 150 records matching the phase4b_expansion cohort. This is the source of truth for release gating.

legacy_manifests.discrepancy: Contains 2 phantom record IDs not present in the authoritative 150-record manifest
legacy_manifests.retention: Preserved for audit trail. Referenced in provenance investigation at docs/v0.2_review_id_origin_investigation.md and docs/v0.2_batch_002_id_repair_report.md.

legacy_manifests.discrepancy: Identical content to metadata/v0.2_review_manifest_current.json — appears to be a copy rather than a distinct investigation artifact

phantom_ids.root_cause: Batch-input generator read subcategory from wrong metadata field — assigned 'general_reasoning' instead of 'instruction_following'
phantom_ids.evidence: Record f4_01_foundation_instruction_following_0011 exists in batch_002.jsonl (decision: approved). No record with the phantom ID f4_01_foundation_general_reasoning_0011 exists in any decision file or curated dataset.

phantom_ids.root_cause: Batch-input generator assigned 'rag' subcategory instead of the correct 'transformers' subcategory
phantom_ids.evidence: Record m3_04_ai_machine_learning_transformers_0009 exists in batch_002.jsonl (decision: approved). No record with the phantom ID m3_04_ai_machine_learning_rag_0009 exists in any decision file or curated dataset.

record_count_reconciliation.verification: Every canonical record ID in the 150-record manifest exists in the curated dataset. The 2 phantom IDs do not correspond to any real record payload.

decision_file_alignment.explanation: The 2 decision IDs in batch_002 with correct subcategory values do not match the phantom IDs that were erroneously added to the 152-record manifests. The 150-record manifest also lacks these 2 IDs — meaning they were never added to the authoritative manifest at all. The manifest was generated before the batch-input generator created the phantom IDs, so the authoritative 150-record manifest never had these records.
decision_file_alignment.action: No action required. The 2 Batch 002 decision records with canonical IDs (f4_01_foundation_instruction_following_0011, m3_04_ai_machine_learning_transformers_0009) are valid decisions on existing manifest records. No manifest update or decision repair is needed for the reconciliation — the manifest discrepancy is purely an artifact of two legacy files that were generated with phantom IDs.

release_gate_impact.note: Manifest reconciliation does not alter release gate state. All 150 authoritative manifest records remain pending. Release remains BLOCKED.
